extracted_concepts.name: Percentage
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A fraction expressed as parts per hundred, denoted %

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Comparison of two or more quantities by division; includes rates

extracted_concepts.name: Standard form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Writing numbers as a x 10^n where 1 <= a < 10

extracted_concepts.name: Significant figures
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Digits carrying meaning for precision; used in estimation and bounds of accuracy

extracted_concepts.name: Algebraic expressions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Combinations of variables, numbers and operations that can be simplified

extracted_concepts.name: Linear equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equations whose highest power of the variable is 1

extracted_concepts.name: Simultaneous linear equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Two or more linear equations solved together for common solutions

extracted_concepts.name: Quadratic equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equations ax^2 + bx + c = 0 solved by factorizing or the quadratic formula

extracted_concepts.name: Inequalities
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Statements using <, >, <=, >= solved like equations with sign care

extracted_concepts.name: Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rules mapping each input to exactly one output

extracted_concepts.name: Cartesian coordinate system
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: System locating points by ordered pairs (x, y) on perpendicular axes

extracted_concepts.name: Gradient
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Steepness of a line: rise over run between two points

extracted_concepts.name: Equation of a straight line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line written as y = mx + c with gradient m and y-intercept c

extracted_concepts.name: Area and volume formulas
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Standard formulas for length, area, surface area and volume of shapes and solids

extracted_concepts.name: Arc length and sector area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Fractional parts of a circle's circumference and area

extracted_concepts.name: Speed, distance, time
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relationship speed = distance / time and its rearrangements

extracted_concepts.name: Circle theorems
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Angle properties of chords, tangents, cyclic quadrilaterals and angles in segments

extracted_concepts.name: Enlargement
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Transformation scaling a figure by a scale factor from a centre

extracted_concepts.name: SOH CAH TOA
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: sin = opposite/hypotenuse, cos = adjacent/hypotenuse, tan = opposite/adjacent

extracted_concepts.name: Sine rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C for any triangle

extracted_concepts.name: Cosine rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc cos A for any triangle

extracted_concepts.name: Vectors
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Quantities with magnitude and direction, written as column vectors

extracted_concepts.name: Transformations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Reflection, rotation, translation and enlargement of figures

extracted_concepts.name: Probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Measure of likelihood of events on a scale from 0 to 1

extracted_concepts.name: Tree diagrams
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Branching diagrams listing outcomes of successive events with probabilities

extracted_concepts.name: Conditional probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Probability of an event given that another event has occurred

extracted_concepts.name: Mean, median, mode, range
aliases: 平均数、中位数、众数、极差
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) and spread (range)

extracted_concepts.name: Histograms
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Bar charts of grouped continuous data with bar area proportional to frequency

extracted_concepts.name: Matrices
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rectangular arrays of numbers supporting addition, subtraction and multiplication

extracted_concepts.name: Determinants
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Scalar value ad - bc of a 2x2 matrix (extended to 3x3)

extracted_concepts.name: Inverse matrices
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix A^-1 such that A A^-1 = I, used to solve matrix equations

extracted_concepts.name: Sets
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Collections of objects with union, intersection and complement operations

extracted_concepts.name: Venn diagrams
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Diagrams showing sets and their overlaps within a universal set

extracted_concepts.name: Radians
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Angle measure based on arc length; pi radians = 180 degrees

extracted_concepts.name: Trigonometric identities
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equations true for all angles, e.g. sin^2 x + cos^2 x = 1

extracted_concepts.name: Indices
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Laws of powers such as a^m x a^n = a^(m+n)

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithms
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Inverse of exponentiation: if a^x = b then log_a b = x

extracted_concepts.name: Factor theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: (x - a) is a factor of polynomial f(x) if and only if f(a) = 0

extracted_concepts.name: Remainder theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The remainder when f(x) is divided by (x - a) equals f(a)

extracted_concepts.name: Kinematics
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Motion under constant acceleration; distance-time and velocity-time graphs
